standard_prerequisites.name: Direct sums described by four morphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, Lemma lemma-preadditive-direct-sum and the description of a direct sum by its two injections and two projections
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the identities satisfied by the four structure morphisms, in particular that the composite of the first injection with the first projection is the identity and that a certain sum of two composites is the identity of the direct sum.

core_obligations: The kernel statement (proof lines 479-486): for a morphism f into the direct sum killed by the projection q, the identity of the direct sum written as the sum of the two composites shows that f factors as the injection i composed with p f, which gives existence in the universal property of the kernel, and uniqueness follows because the composite p i is the identity.
The cokernel statement (proof line 487): the dual assertion follows by duality.
proof_roadmap: Write the identity of the direct sum in terms of the four structure morphisms.
Factor any morphism killed by the projection through the injection.
Get uniqueness from the other composite being the identity, and dualize.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that in a preadditive category the first injection of a direct sum is a kernel of the second projection, and dually the first projection is a cokernel of the second injection (statement lines 469-477). The proof is a complete argument: for a morphism into the direct sum killed by the projection, the identity of the direct sum decomposed into the two composites exhibits the required factorisation, and uniqueness is read off from the composite of projection and injection (proof lines 479-486); the dual statement follows by duality (proof line 487). The non-formal content is the decomposition of the identity and the factorisation. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
